checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.description: These must be done before closing: a safe count, the next day's prices, every shift closed, and for a past day every expense and credit payment decided. Warnings do not stop the close but are shown to the owner.

SAFE_COUNT.done: The safe was counted on this day
SAFE_COUNT.missing: Count the safe — no safe count was recorded on this day

NEXT_DAY_PRICES.done: Next day's fuel prices are set or confirmed
NEXT_DAY_PRICES.missing: Set or confirm the next day's fuel prices ({{fuelTypes}})

OPEN_SHIFTS.done: Every shift of this day is closed
OPEN_SHIFTS.missing_one: Close or hand over {{count}} open shift of this day first
OPEN_SHIFTS.missing_other: Close or hand over {{count}} open shifts of this day first

checks.OPEN_SHIFTS_one: {{count}} shift is still open — it is left out of this day's figures
checks.OPEN_SHIFTS_other: {{count}} shifts are still open — they are left out of this day's figures
checks.TANKS_WITHOUT_DIP_one: {{count}} active tank has no dip reading on this day
checks.TANKS_WITHOUT_DIP_other: {{count}} active tanks have no dip reading on this day
checks.PENDING_CASH_DROPS_one: {{count}} cash drop of {{amount}} is still waiting to be confirmed
checks.PENDING_CASH_DROPS_other: {{count}} cash drops worth {{amount}} are still waiting to be confirmed
checks.DELIVERIES_NOT_CHECKED_one: {{count}} delivery on this day has no receipt check
checks.DELIVERIES_NOT_CHECKED_other: {{count}} deliveries on this day have no receipt check

PENDING_EXPENSES.missing_one: {{count}} expense of {{amount}} dated this day is waiting for approval
PENDING_EXPENSES.missing_other: {{count}} expenses worth {{amount}} dated this day are waiting for approval

checks.PENDING_EXPENSES_one: {{count}} expense of {{amount}} dated this day is waiting for approval

checks.PENDING_CREDIT_PAYMENTS_other: {{count}} credit payments worth {{amount}} dated this day are waiting for approval

reasons.SALES_OK: All {{shiftCount}} shifts of the day are closed and counted
reasons.SALES_NO_CLOSED_SHIFTS: No closed shifts on this day, so there are no sales figures
reasons.SALES_OPEN_SHIFTS_EXCLUDED: {{count}} open shift(s) are left out of these figures
reasons.SALES_COST_MISSING: {{fuelTypeCode}} was sold with no purchase cost, so its margin is too high
reasons.SALES_NEGATIVE_MARGIN: The day lost {{amount}}: sales were below purchase cost
reasons.CASH_OK: Cash, payments and the safe all match
reasons.CASH_NO_SAFE_COUNT: The safe was not counted on this day
reasons.CASH_SAFE_BEYOND_TOLERANCE: Safe count is {{varianceTypeCode}} by {{amount}}, beyond the {{toleranceAmount}} tolerance
reasons.CASH_SAFE_SMALL_VARIANCE: Safe count is {{varianceTypeCode}} by {{amount}}, within tolerance
reasons.CASH_SHIFT_SHORTAGES: {{count}} shift(s) came up short by {{amount}} in total
reasons.CASH_PENDING_DROPS: {{count}} cash drop(s) of {{amount}} not yet confirmed
reasons.STOCK_OK: Tanks and deliveries are within limits
reasons.STOCK_TANK_OUTSIDE_TOLERANCE: Tank {{tankIdentifier}} is off by {{litres}}, outside its tolerance
reasons.STOCK_TANKS_NOT_DIPPED: {{count}} tank(s) had no dip on this day
reasons.STOCK_OPEN_CLAIMS: {{count}} shortage claim(s) of {{amount}} still open with suppliers
reasons.CREDIT_OK: No overdue credit and no open alerts
reasons.CREDIT_OVER_LIMIT: {{count}} credit client(s) are over their credit limit
